gse244832.allowed_use: Donor-compatible external-development accessibility evaluation only; RNA and ATAC are same-sample different aliquots and never cell-paired.
gse244832.model_access: No use in fitting or calibration for a GSE244832 development score.

gse289173.allowed_use: One-time sealed variant-to-regulation inference after selection lock; the sequence-only model receives only evaluator-approved anonymized variants and reference sequence.
gse289173.model_access: No cell-state labels, eQTL/ieQTL outcomes, calibration values, or ATAC profiles are available to training.

gse296875.allowed_use: Outer-fold training of cell-state-specific accessibility models and donor-held retrospective evaluation; pathology fields are used only in the prespecified donor-level error audit.
gse296875.model_access: Only outer-training donors and permitted genomic blocks contribute fragments, peaks, nonpeaks, bias models, normalization, or early stopping.

local_model_roster.donor_pooling: Within each outer fold, pseudobulk fragments by donor and cell state, retain donor-level QC, then pool only outer-training donors for model fitting.
local_model_roster.genomic_split: Cross donor folds with chromosome/merged-LD blocks; peaks, nonpeaks, bias models, and early stopping obey both exclusions.
local_model_roster.unseen_state_policy: No nearest-state substitution. An untrained or QC-failed state is structurally missing and cannot be scored.

rules.donor_inference: Cells, nuclei, fragments, peaks, and genomic windows are not biological replicates.
rules.missingness: Missing cell states or low-depth donor-state profiles use explicit missingness states, never zero profiles.
rules.sealed_chronology: Project-trained artifacts are eligible only if their campaign inputs and timestamps predate one-time sealed inference and their prediction hashes are committed before outcome joining.
